subject: Request: Temporary No-PO Onboarding for SupplyNova pilot
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@supplynova.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: acct@supplynova.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding — pilot with Redwood (requesting temporary no-PO workflow)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at SupplyNova is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot integrating our data connectors with Redwood. Our procurement team typically requires a PO for recurring SaaS invoices, but for short pilots we route invoices directly while we finalize purchasing terms.

We wanted to ask whether Redwood can accept the pilot invoices without a PO for up to $12,000 in spend (single invoice or cumulative) and route them to acct@supplynova.com. If that's not possible we need to understand the minimal procurement artifacts you need to complete vendor setup (W-9, SOC2, invoice instructions, contact).

Attached: SupplyNova-W9.pdf and a link to our SOC2 report.

Is there a standard one-time waiver process we should follow? Happy to provide any forms.

Best,
Daniel Park
Head of Partnerships, SupplyNova
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@supplynova.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — pilot with Redwood (requesting temporary no-PO workflow)

Daniel — thanks for the clear note and the W-9. Appreciate the SOC2 link.

Short answer: we can sometimes approve a time-limited no-PO routing for pilots, but procurement needs a signed vendor onboarding form plus an internal approval from Procurement/Finance for any invoice routing exceptions. Can you complete our onboarding form (I attached the PDF) and confirm the pilot start/end dates and the expected invoice cadence?

For exceptions we typically require:
- Completed Vendor Onboarding Form (attached)
- SOC2 Type II (link/attachment)
- Proposed spend cap + invoice schedule
- Contact for remittance and tax information

If you can return the form I will loop in Monica (Procurement) for the formal review. If there's an urgent invoice before approval, let me know the amount and we can evaluate a provisional one-off exception.

Thanks — looking forward to getting SupplyNova onto the platform.

– Kimberly Park
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — pilot with Redwood (requesting temporary no-PO workflow)

Kimberly —

Thanks for the heads-up. Monica from Procurement here. A few clarifying points before we can approve any temporary no-PO routing:

1) We require a completed onboarding form and W-9 on file (attached: Vendor-Onboarding-Form-SupplyNova.pdf stub).
2) We need to confirm SOC2 or equivalent evidence (link provided by Daniel).
3) Any no-PO invoice routing will be limited to a single month and capped — propose a $12,000 cap as they requested.
4) We will need a purchase-reconciliation contact at SupplyNova and confirmation if invoices will be billed to the SupplyNova legal entity on the W-9.

If the vendor agrees to these items I will prepare a one-time No-PO Waiver that needs sign-off from Finance (Priyom). Please confirm the exact invoice dates and whether SupplyNova can accept our standard net-30 terms for the pilot invoices.

Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@supplynova.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — pilot with Redwood (requesting temporary no-PO workflow)

Hi Monica / Kimberly —

Thanks — attached is the completed onboarding form and the SOC2 link again: https://drive.google.com/supplynova/soc2-2026. Invoices will be sent once at the end of the pilot (expected 2027-01-08) to acct@supplynova.com and billed to SupplyNova Inc. (EIN on W-9). Net-30 is fine.

We can accept a single-month exception and the $12,000 cap. Please share the waiver for signature.

Attachments included: Vendor-Onboarding-Form-SupplyNova.pdf, SupplyNova-W9.pdf (re-attached).

— Daniel
From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Approval: One-time no-PO invoice routing for SupplyNova pilot (conditions)

Monica / Kimberly —

I've reviewed the package for PF-4521. Approve a one-time exception to route the pilot invoice without a PO under these conditions:
- Exception limited to one invoice, single payment, cap at $12,000
- Vendor onboarding form, W-9, and SOC2 Type II link on file
- Invoice must be dated 2027-01-08 and routed to acct@supplynova.com; Finance will record it under a temporary ledger code for pilot spend
- SupplyNova must confirm remittance contact and legal entity as SupplyNova Inc.

Monica, please generate the One-time No-PO Waiver PDF (One-time-No-PO-Waiver-Approval-KP-20261220.pdf) and attach it to the vendor record; request vendor acknowledgement.

Priyom Das
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@supplynova.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: SupplyNova pilot onboarding — waiver issued and next steps

Daniel — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for completing the onboarding form.

Priyom has approved a one-time No-PO Waiver for the pilot under the conditions he listed. Monica has uploaded the waiver and vendor docs to the portal (links below).

Next steps:
- SupplyNova to acknowledge the waiver and confirm remittance contact (name, email, phone) — reply to this thread
- Redwood will accept a single invoice dated 2027-01-08 for up to $12,000, net-30
- We will add SupplyNova to the Pilot ledger code and track spend against PF-4521

Links / attachments:
- Waiver (One-time-No-PO-Waiver-Approval-KP-20261220.pdf) — attached
- SOC2: https://drive.google.com/supplynova/soc2-2026
- Vendor record: https://app.redwood.com/portal/vendors/PF-4521

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
